download.description.message: Download FolderRewind for Windows from Microsoft Store or x64/ARM64 Setup EXE. Review installation channels, system requirements and bundled MineRewind.

download.subheading.message: Choose an installer for your device and start with one backup

download.notice.desc.message: Keep your configuration and archives before upgrading. When changing installation channels, export configuration and history, import them in the new installation, and check source paths.

download.notice.point1.message: Microsoft Store is recommended first for smoother upgrades.

download.notice.point2.message: Do not run the Store and Setup channels concurrently.

download.notice.point3.message: Switching installation channels does not migrate configs or plugins automatically; back up your data first.

download.notice.upgradeLink.message: Read the1.9 upgrade and recovery guide

download.store.desc.message: Auto updates, simpler installation, and the recommended long-term installation option.

download.msi.desc.message: The current GitHub stable release is 1.9.6. Choose x64 or ARM64 Setup EXE and verify its matching .sha256 file.

download.archHint.message: Choose x64 for most Intel/AMD PCs. Choose ARM64 only for Windows on Arm devices.

download.sysreq.disk.value.message: Use official installer figures; archives require extra space

download.plugin.minerewind.desc.message: Version 1.9.6 bundles MineRewind 1.9.8 with Java map preview, save discovery and region backup. The separate public package is still 1.9.5 (API 3.6) without map preview; the Host supports API 3.9.

minecraft.ecosystem.intro.message: Choose a component by runtime scenario, then read its installation steps, compatibility matrix, and safety boundaries.

minecraft.ecosystem.minebackupMod.descri.message: The in-game integration mod coordinates saves, exits, hot backup, hot restore, and automatic rejoin.

minecraft.ecosystem.minebackupPlugin.des.message: A Spigot/Paper server plugin that safely hands world restore over to a Sidecar process.

minecraft.ecosystem.deathRewind.descript.message: Creates periodic checkpoints and restores the latest archive from the singleplayer death screen.

minecraft.ecosystem.jea.description.message: Detects high-risk states and creates a world snapshot that can be used to recover from an accident.

minecraft.ecosystem.jea.audience.message: Fabric / NeoForge / Forge singleplayer or LAN worlds

notFound.message.message: The page you requested does not exist or has moved. Try one of these destinations.

homepage.v2.heroCopy.message: Keep a history of your important files, and a way back from accidental edits and deletions.

homepage.v2.startCopy.message: Make your first backup, test a restore, then set up a routine that works for you.

homepage.v2.installCopy.message: Choose an installation method and a separate location for your backups.

homepage.v2.backupCopy.message: Add your documents, design projects or personal files. Save a starting point.

homepage.v2.verifyCopy.message: Check the restored files in a test copy before enabling automatic backups.

homepage.v2.previewTitle.message: See where your files have been.

homepage.v2.previewCopy.message: Organize projects, browse their history and review a restore in a familiar Windows interface.

homepage.v2.homeCaption.message: Organize your folders by project, with everyday documents and game saves in one place.

homepage.v2.historyCaption.message: Review versions, notes and restore status to find the point you want to return to.

homepage.v2.restoreCaption.message: Before restoring, check the version, destination and restore mode, including whether backup before restore is enabled.

homepage.v2.homeAlt.message: FolderRewind home with documents, design, personal files and game backup projects

homepage.v2.historyAlt.message: FolderRewind advanced history with versions, notes, branches and restore status

homepage.v2.restoreAlt.message: FolderRewind restore confirmation showing destination, scope and the backup-before-restore warning

homepage.v2.featuresTitle.message: A plan for backups. A path to recovery.

homepage.v2.featuresCopy.message: Make protecting your files part of your everyday workflow.

homepage.v2.featureBackupCopy.message: Save a full copy or capture changes. Choose Full, Smart or Rolling and a retention policy that fits your files.

homepage.v2.featureHistoryCopy.message: Organize history with versions, branches and recovery points. Check destinations and protection options before restoring.

homepage.v2.featureAutoCopy.message: Schedule backups or set conditions, and use tools such as rclone to keep cloud copies in your own storage.

homepage.v2.ecoTitle.message: For the files that make life yours.

homepage.v2.gameCopy.message: Keep a history of your worlds. Minecraft hot backup and restore require the corresponding plugins or mods.

homepage.v2.pluginsCopy.message: Connect apps, games and automation through the independent plugin SDK and KnotLink.

homepage.v2.downloadTitle.message: Give your important files a way back.

homepage.v2.downloadCopy.message: Start with your first backup today.

homepage.v2.seo.message: FolderRewind is an open-source Windows backup tool for documents, projects and game saves, with version history, automation, recovery points and cloud copies.

homepage.v2.mergeCaption.message: Compare text side by side, resolve file conflicts and review the result before applying.

homepage.v2.mapCaption.message: Explore Java terrain in a read-only map, switch dimensions, navigate coordinates and inspect chunks.

homepage.v2.mergeAlt.message: FolderRewind 1.9.6 merge workspace with text differences, file conflicts and result review

homepage.v2.mapAlt.message: Read-only Minecraft Java terrain map in FolderRewind 1.9.6
